source.title: Mammalian Shaker Kv1.2 potassium channel-beta subunit complex
source.citation: Long SB, Campbell EB, MacKinnon R. Crystal structure of a mammalian voltage-dependent Shaker family K+ channel. Science 2005;309(5736):897-903. doi:10.1126/science.1116269

source.note: A channel of the rat, made in yeast, and the channel of the mouse is not known from this entry. The biological assembly has four copies of each chain. Parts of the voltage sensors were built only as chains of unknown sequence.
